source_name: European Commission LCDN PEF/OEF node registry
licence_summary: Access and use are controlled by each node owner; EC-owned nodes are free, but dataset-level terms still need checking.
recommended_action: Use as a discovery catalogue only. Evaluate every dataset and EULA individually.
evidence_note: Official registry says node owners regulate access; some data are free, some require free or paid registration.

source_name: European Solvents Industry Group EF 3.1 LCA Database
coverage: Solvents, including glycol ethers and hydrocarbon solvents
access: Metadata public; inventory and LCIA results restricted until registration
licence_summary: Free only for some user/use types under a linked Sphera/thinkstep EULA. General website redistribution is not established.
licence_expiry: User/use-specific; verify current EULA before use
recommended_action: Use metadata to identify supplier/process matches. Obtain written permission or a suitable licence before importing values.
evidence_note: Example process pages expose metadata only and require registration for full inputs/outputs and LCIA results.

source_name: CEPE chemicals for paints / printing inks EF data
coverage: Paint and printing-ink chemicals, including resins and related materials
licence_summary: Listed free PEF/OEF use was explicitly limited to 31 December 2024.
recommended_action: Do not import or redistribute. Contact CEPE/ecoinvent for current licensing.
evidence_note: Dataset page limits use to regular PEF/OEF studies under specified rules exclusively until 31 December 2024.

coverage: Chemicals, plastics, apparel and other EF datasets
access: Discontinued PEF node; current ecoinvent database requires licence
licence_summary: Integrating ecoinvent data into software or internal tools requires a developer licence.
recommended_action: Do not import into the website without a signed developer/sub-licensing arrangement.
evidence_note: ecoinvent states the PEF node was discontinued in December 2025 and software integration requires a developer licence.

coverage: Small number of public EF 3.1 representative-product/background datasets currently visible
licence_summary: Individual example dataset pages state “No restrictions”; verify each dataset before import.
recommended_action: Catalogue the node. Import only datasets whose own metadata explicitly permits reuse and whose functional unit is relevant.
evidence_note: A synthetic-turf background dataset page states “No restrictions”; the public stock is not a broad industrial LCI database.

licence_summary: The published EULA ceased the right to use the datasets after 31 December 2025 unless a new licence is obtained.
recommended_action: Do not import. Contact the licensor for a current agreement if feed/agrofood data become necessary.
evidence_note: EULA says use ceases automatically after 31 December 2025 and a new licence is required from 2026.

coverage: Agrofood and other EF pilot datasets
access: Node reported down in registry; current endpoint unavailable during review
licence_summary: Not assessed because node is unavailable.
recommended_action: Do not automate against this node. Reassess only if the owner restores service and publishes current terms.
evidence_note: Official registry marked the node down in March 2023.

access: Node reported down in registry; endpoint unavailable during review
licence_summary: Not assessed because node is unavailable.
recommended_action: Do not automate against this node.
evidence_note: Official registry marked the node down in March 2023.

source_name: European Commission Small Data Providers node — EF 3.1 hydrogen
licence_summary: At least some dataset pages explicitly license reuse under CC BY 4.0 with attribution and indication of changes. Check every dataset.
recommended_action: Build a dataset-level importer that reads licence metadata. Import only explicit CC BY/no-restriction records.
evidence_note: Example 2024 JRC dataset states CC BY 4.0 reuse is allowed with attribution and changes indicated.

coverage: Energy, transport, packaging, end-of-life, plastics, electronics, metals and minerals
licence_summary: General PEF/OEF and taxonomy/new-consumer-agenda uses ended 31 December 2025. Certain other EU-policy uses continue to 31 December 2030; general website use is not covered.
licence_expiry: 2025-12-31 for general PEF/OEF use; 2030-12-31 only for defined other EU-policy uses
recommended_action: Do not import for the general website. Contact Sphera for an appropriate database/software licence.
evidence_note: EULA limits permitted uses and dates; general PEF/OEF rights ceased after 2025.

source_name: UK Government GHG Conversion Factors for Company Reporting 2026
owner: Department for Energy Security and Net Zero
coverage: Electricity, fuels, heat, freight, waste, water, materials, refrigerants and corporate activity categories
licence_summary: Open Government Licence v3.0, except where otherwise stated. Attribution required.
licence_expiry: Annual factor set; use for activity mainly in 2026
recommended_action: Import the normalized numeric rows in this pack. Treat them as characterised GHG conversion factors, not as a complete unit-process LCI.
evidence_note: Official revised flat file; 2026 factors are intended for UK activities and may be used for other purposes at the user’s risk.

source_name: Federal LCA Commons / USLCI and partner repositories
owner: US federal agencies and contributing repositories
coverage: Public process LCI data across energy, materials, fuels, agriculture and industrial processes
access: Public portal/API; some endpoints may require API credentials
licence_summary: Rights and quality can vary by repository/dataset; do not assume one blanket licence.
recommended_action: Add an API connector later. Persist repository, UUID, version and licence metadata; require human approval before import.
evidence_note: Useful public LCI source, but US geography and dataset-specific terms require review.

source_name: ProBas process-oriented base data for environmental management
coverage: European/German process data for materials, energy, fuels, transport and other processes
licence_summary: Attribution and provider-specific conditions apply; third-party datasets may carry additional rights.
recommended_action: Use for research and selected imports only after checking the exact process/provider terms. Do not bulk mirror automatically.
evidence_note: Strong free European research source; licence treatment is less straightforward for a public software database than OGL data.

coverage: Construction products, materials, energy, transport and disposal datasets
licence_summary: Unmodified data may be distributed with source attribution, subject to dataset/provider conditions.
recommended_action: Useful for common construction/material/transport/disposal factors. Keep source dataset and module/boundary information intact.
evidence_note: Good reuse terms but primarily construction-oriented, so applicability must be checked.

licence_summary: Legacy dataset terms vary; data are obsolete and no longer maintained.
recommended_action: Keep for testing and clearly labelled legacy proxies; do not make it the primary verification-grade database.
evidence_note: ELCD was discontinued because datasets became obsolete and were no longer updated.

licence_summary: Method-pack terms apply. This is not an LCI database.
recommended_action: Do not import as material factors. Use only if the website later stores elementary flows and implements LCIA characterisation.
evidence_note: LCIA methods convert elementary flows to impact results; they do not supply product/material inventories.
